scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: There was no standing water anywhere on the shop floor, and the flexible cord feeding the pedestal fan has its outer jacket worn through to the conductors.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The rack uprights showed no impact damage, however the top beam clip on bay nine has popped out of its slot and the beam is resting on one connector.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The extension ladder showed no split rails, however the shoes are worn smooth and it was set at close to eighty degrees on a painted floor.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: A shop mechanic is performing heavy solvent degreasing in an enclosed room with no local exhaust ventilation.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: If the level probe on the caustic tank were to fail closed during a transfer, the vent could pressurise and lift the manway gasket.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The ladder cage on the silo did not look right to me and the third hoop has parted from the stringer with the fixings pulled clean through.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The tongue guard on the bench grinder is gone; I could not say whether maintenance removed it or it broke off.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The overhead door track struck me as odd when I walked underneath it.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: One of the sling legs on the spreader bar may be cut.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: There was a puddle of something under the parts washer and I could not tell what it was or where it came from.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The mezzanine gate did not look right to me and the lower hinge pin is sheared off with the gate hanging on the top hinge alone.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: Crew was changing the knives on the granulator; no LOTO is applied and the guard is missing.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: An employee on a rolling scaffold at nine feet was using an angle grinder without a face shield while a propane forklift idled directly underneath refueling from a portable cylinder.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: welding on the mezz rail, no fire watch, cardboard and pallets stacked under where the sparks were landing, extinguisher in the area was last inspected 2 yrs ago per the tag

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The rail on the platform did not look right to me.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: Steel erectors were connecting at the second tier with no guardrail, safety net or personal fall arrest system in use.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: Every point of operation on the punch press line is enclosed by a fixed barrier guard, the interlocks were function tested at the start of shift, and the test log was signed.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The whole grinding bay looked right to me and the wheel guards are all fitted with the tool rests set within an eighth of an inch.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The guarding survey of the wrapping line found no exposed nip points and no reachable rotating shafts anywhere on the machine.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The chipper infeed was de-energized at the disconnect, both millwrights hung personal locks, and the stored spring tension was released and verified before the housing came off.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: The scissor lift was red tagged and taken out of service after the pothole protection failed to deploy during the function check.

scenarios.source: L3-2d development (drawn from opened sets)
scenarios.text: A shop-made extension lead with a taped joint was found at the weld bay and the electrician cut it out of service and issued a factory assembled lead before we left the area.

scenarios.text: Main plant electrical panel is blocked by a pile of discarded conveyor rollers and debris.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The damaged extension lead was found at the panel and was discarded before we left the area.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: Crew was changing the knives on the granulator and no lockout is applied at the disconnect.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The crew stopped work and a full lockout was applied at the disconnect before the guard came off.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: A plastic jug of solvent is stored on the open shelf without hazard warning labels of any kind.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The inspection of the switch room found no damage and no exposed conductors anywhere on the panels.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The survey found no damage to the enclosure although the earth conductor has been cut back and left unterminated.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The chain guard has been removed from the drive and was not refitted after the belt change.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The grinder with the cracked wheel was removed from service and tagged before the shift ended.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The crew reported that no guardrail was in place along the open edge of the deck.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: Two men were on the roof near the edge; I was too far away to see whether they were tied off to anything.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The tongue guard on the bench grinder is missing entirely; I could not read the machine serial number from where I stood.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: No flammable atmosphere was detected at the manway, and the fitter went inside the vessel with the agitator still on line and nobody at the opening.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The atmosphere was tested at the manway, and the fitter went inside the vessel with the agitator still on line and nobody at the opening.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: Looked at the chemical store on the way past.

scenarios.source: L3-2e development (drawn from opened sets and E1/E2 root-cause fixtures)
scenarios.text: The way the acetylene bottles were standing in the corner of the weld bay did not sit right with me.
